posts.body:
A friend says sorry for taking days to reply. If you’re fine with it, try:

没关系。Méi guānxi. It’s okay.

That short reply can take the pressure off and let you get back to the conversation.

Mini-fable: Rabbit knocked over a cup. He braced for a lecture. Turtle handed him a cloth.

没关系。我们一起擦吧。
Méi guānxi. Wǒmen yìqǐ cā ba.
It’s okay. Let’s wipe it up together.

Listen for 吧 (ba): here it turns the cleanup into a suggestion.
